source_snapshot.items: Serial Port Console Redirection - Enable & Disabled
source_snapshot.procedure: Set BIOS Console Redirection Disabled, save/reboot and confirm no COM boot progress; then Enabled, save/reboot and confirm boot progress; source also clears logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Boot progress absent while Disabled and present while Enabled.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; correctly assigns both BIOS mutation and physical serial observation to an operator but supplies no port identity, line settings, bounded capture or signature oracle.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY; adds exact SUT/COM binding, baud/protocol and boot-signature inputs, two bounded reboot captures, recovery and baseline restoration.

historical_reviews.deepseek: The manual conclusion fits the workflow, but an unbound terminal can observe stale or cross-connected output and cannot prove either state.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Classification and case-specific controls are accepted; the Disabled negative assertion is strengthened with a known-good pre/post serial-path check so silence is not mistaken for a disconnected cable.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code searches found no duplicate variant or earlier completed record.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Enabled and Disabled are paired functional checkpoints on the same verified serial path; negative evidence requires proving capture remained alive and correctly attached throughout the Disabled boot.

original_test_intent: Have a qualified operator prove that the verified COM terminal suppresses boot-progress output when BIOS Console Redirection is Disabled and emits the approved boot-progress signature when Enabled, with saved-state persistence across each reboot.
original_method: Bind one SUT, firmware serial interface, physical adapter and terminal configuration; record baseline; set/save/re-read Disabled and collect a bounded boot capture with path-liveness evidence, then set/save/re-read Enabled and collect the matching positive signature; restore and verify the baseline when required.
manual_activity: A qualified operator controls BIOS and the physical/attached serial terminal, verifies cable/port identity and line settings, performs both save/reboot observations and restores the approved final state.
required_inputs: BIOS Serial Port Console Redirection path and baseline
Physical COM header/port, adapter and terminal identity
Baud, data bits, parity, stop bits, flow control and encoding
Approved boot-progress signature and capture window
Path-liveness method for the Disabled negative result
Qualified operator, reboot approval and recovery path
safety_requirements: Obtain approval before BIOS writes and both reboots
Prove the serial cable/adapter/terminal belongs to the target
Do not accept silence without path-liveness evidence
Do not clear dmesg, syslog or SEL
Stop on wrong port, garbled/ambiguous data, failed save, boot failure or lost recovery access
No automatic retry or hidden baud probing
Restore and verify baseline/final console access
agent_execution_scope: Support read-only identity and boot-health collection
Coordinate but do not claim BIOS or physical console control
Record exact terminal settings and timestamped captures
Compare only approved boot signatures within the bounded windows
Verify operator-supplied save/re-entry and final-state evidence
engineer_actions: Approve port mapping, line settings, signature, windows and final state
Perform or supervise physical terminal and BIOS steps
Resolve ambiguous output/recovery and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly identifies an operator-only procedure, but provides no executable command and no controls against disconnected-path false negatives.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Manual operator: on the verified COM path, save/re-read Disabled and capture one bounded boot proving path liveness plus absence of the boot signature; repeat Enabled and prove the positive signature, then restore baseline.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both Disabled/Enabled states, two reboot observations and 45/45-minute estimates remain; log clearing is prohibited.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture a state-tagged tuple for each reboot: BIOS value, COM topology, line settings, capture start/end, path-liveness marker, approved boot signature result, boot completion and final restoration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target/port binding and a defensible negative-evidence method while preserving the physical serial observation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: OS console or BMC SOL output cannot substitute unless the project proves it is the same firmware serial-redirection path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Disabling console redirection can remove a recovery channel; electrical/adapter faults and incorrect line settings can mimic the expected Disabled result.

project_override_considerations: A validated serial-capture appliance may automate collection but the BIOS mutation and physical-path validation remain operator-controlled in this workflow. SOL is equivalent only with documented path equivalence to the tested COM interface.
expected_evidence: SUT/BIOS identity, approval, baseline and exact COM/adapter/terminal topology
Line settings, capture windows and approved boot signature
Disabled BIOS save/re-entry plus live-path capture showing signature absent
Enabled BIOS save/re-entry plus capture showing signature present
Boot/reachability and preserved event evidence for both reboots
Baseline/final-state recovery and engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define paired Disabled/Enabled serial boot-output behavior. Missing COM configuration and signature are readiness inputs rather than contradictory source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The manual test is defined once the owner supplies the verified serial path, settings, signature, operator and recovery plan.

review_improvement: Makes the Disabled negative assertion auditable, prevents wrong-port false results and binds both BIOS states to saved values and the same serial path.
independent_technical_reasoning: Absence of serial text is only meaningful when the receiver, adapter and target port are demonstrably live. Pairing that negative capture with an Enabled positive capture on unchanged wiring distinguishes actual firmware redirection control from a disconnected or misconfigured terminal.
